messages:
ajay (eng-platform): Heads-up: AcmeRetail dedicated pool-west-2 is seeing ~12% 503s since 06:20 UTC. Spike seems tied to a burst of embedding requests. Opening thread to align owners and a short workaround. INC-2451 :eyes:

sre-bot: Incident INC-2451 created and paged to oncall. Pager duty: lisa (oncall).

maria (prod-eng): Any recent deploys or routing changes? logs?

ajay (eng-platform): No prod deploys in the last 24h. Quick log snippet from gateway:```[2025-05-12T06:22:11Z] ERROR request_id=abc123 status=503 pool=pool-west-2 route=embed-small model=redwood-2b shards=3 qps=120 backlog=48
[2025-05-12T06:22:12Z] WARN kvcache_miss prefix_key=acct:acmeretail token=...
```

tony (eng-runtime): Looks like KV cache spike + backlog. Quick mitigation: route embed-small -> embed-fallback (lower mem model) and increase pool by +2 nodes. Can we flip routing policy?

lisa (oncall): I can own the workaround. Will enable fallback routing and request +2 nodes from autoscaler now. ETA ~20m. Command I'm going to run:```curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/pools/pool-west-2/scale -d '{"add":2}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'```Also setting route override:```PATCH /routes/embed-small {"fallback_model":"embed-fallback-v1","max_queue":200}```

ajay (eng-platform): Thanks lisa. Priya (CSM) — told customer we're investigating and gave a 30m update window.

priya (csm): Yup pinged them. They're anxious about SLA window — please call out ETA if we expect extended impact.

 dan (eng-sre): Quick nit: this might be exacerbated by retry storm from client side. Can we temporarily increase client-side retry jitter and lower backend retry attempts? I can push a config change to the edge.

maria (prod-eng): I pushed a tiny PR (diff is a one-line guard) to reduce concurrent embed workers in that pool: PR #678. Needs one review. Can someone with runtime context +1?

tony (eng-runtime): I'll review now. If rollback is safer, we can route back to redwood-1.4b until PR is in. Tradeoff: slightly higher latency, lower OOM/503.

lisa (oncall): Workaround applied at 06:50 UTC: fallback routing enabled +2 nodes scaled. Errors down to ~0.8% in the last 5m. Monitoring for 15m before unblocking customer. :thumbsup:

ajay (eng-platform): Copy — great work. I'll log postmortem and scope RCA items: (1) retry gating (dan), (2) cache hotkey protection (maria), (3) autoscaler headroom for embeds (runtime). Setting owner tags and due dates.

priya (csm): Sharing to AcmeRetail that errors are reduced, ETA for detailed update 45m. Thanks team.

maria (prod-eng): Assigned PR #678 to tony +1 requested. quick review link: https://git/redwood/pr/678 :coffee:

tony (eng-runtime): Reviewed + merged. Will follow up on the autoscale policy tweak tomorrow AM.

lisa (oncall): Closing incident for now, keeping it in monitoring. If anything regresses I'll reopen INC-2451.

ajay (eng-platform): Closing thread — filing follow-up tickets for SLA patch (ETA 24h) and RCA doc. Thanks everyone. :hands_together:
